reference.pathophysiology: Cavus-adductus-varus-equinus order with mid-hindfoot Pirani scoring names CTEV for newborn Ponseti starts while supinated-forefoot with talar-head fulcrum and equinus-last sequencing corrects casts; seventy-percent percutaneous tenotomy with twenty-three-hour Denis Browne wear holds correction, and cuboid counterpressure names the Kite error against posteromedial release for resistant feet.
